criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 20 January 2029 (18 months after the 20 July 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the long-stop date as 13 August 2027 (120 days after signing on 15 April 2027) and identifies that expected clearance on 27 August 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.2 is stated as $39,600,000 but 20% of the $220,000,000 Purchase Price is $44,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (20% x $220,000,000 = $44,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $39,600,000.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (20 January 2029), with days remaining from 6 May 2027 (625 days).
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
